name: Hormel Stockton Plant / Fresno - Fresno CA

fieldNotes.location: Roster address '3438 W Pontiac Way' geocoded to a residential neighborhood in NW Fresno - wrong. The Hormel Fresno Plant is the Corn Nuts roasting/packaging facility at 4343 E Florence Ave, Fresno 93725 (SE Fresno industrial area), confirmed via web search (Hormel 'Our Locations' Fresno Plant + Corn Nuts solar-array articles). A matching processing plant with a solar field, trailer docks, and a fenced yard sits at 36.7184,-119.7527. Locked center there. Note: roster name also mentions 'Stockton' - the audited site is the Fresno plant.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully enclosed by a tubular-metal perimeter fence with a landscaped buffer along E Florence Ave. Vehicle access is via gated driveway openings in the fence. A gate is present (medium confidence - Street View only reaches the public road and could not capture the gate panel directly).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at any driveway in Street View (2024-12) or satellite imagery.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no guard shack -> remote/kiosk check-in inferred.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~6-8 dock doors along the west building face with green/white trailers backed in; ~10 total estimated, 0-10 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked in the paved west truck yard plus an adjacent dirt overflow lot with ~8-12 parked trailers; dropArea 10-25, dedicated drop yard present.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Large paved truck yard on the west side easily holds a 3+ truck queue between the gate and the docks.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Open paved truck yard inside the fence before the docks serves as staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the east edge of the property; spur tracks appear to serve a neighboring facility rather than the Hormel building - no clear rail dock on the plant. Marked false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense SE Fresno industrial district (Fresno metro) - Urban.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity concentrated on the single west face - combined ship/receive.
